decisions.reason: The source changes caption positioning only; the clean and simple editing requirements remain unchanged.
Caption positioning does not affect permitted source videos or source-selection constraints.
The source does not change the requirement that each clip deliver a complete standalone lesson or story.
The requested caption-position correction does not modify the standard for selecting impactful moments.
The source discusses text placement and makes no change to the wind-noise cleanup requirement.
The caption-position change does not alter the required 45–60-second clip duration.
Feedback about caption placement has no necessary effect on Lead Clipper responsibilities or advancement.
The source is corrective feedback on current clips and does not change the historical qualification method or success condition.
The source identifies a required correction but does not modify the standing approval authority, counting rule, or rejected-clip handling policy.
The source does not authorize publication, identify the approved clips, or resolve the existing ambiguity about which clips may be posted.
Caption placement feedback does not change the submission channel, folder configuration, or review-link workflow.
The source does not change the monthly approved-clip count, counting rule, cadence, or deferred lifecycle status.
